_readme: What raceforge.py customize takes from the Ascension Character Customization package for the Bleakhold realm, and what it hides (README.md, 'Bleakhold appearance data contract'). Numbers only: option numbers of the pinned package, no art. Hiding sets flag 0x8 on the rows; the rows and their numbers stay. Every hidden row has a reason. Skin groups colour the picker's number (plain, marked, fel; Death Knight skins, flag 0x4, are their own group); a skin not listed is plain. The owner signs off the contact sheets that customize --preview makes on the server; change this file after that review.

package.name: Ascension Character Customization
package.author: Ijostrom
package.credits: Models and textures: Project Ascension. Baked NPC textures and DBC reference: Project Reforged (per the package's README).

hidden.reason: painted clothing: a dark strap harness is painted onto the skin
painted clothing: a bead belt is painted onto the skin (its teal body tattoos are covered by the Moonwell Sigils marks); owner to confirm on the contact sheet
broken: barbershop-only row (flag 0x12) whose skin, underwear and 20 face textures are not in the package
broken: the underwear of the broken skin 21
broken: barbershop-only face rows (flags 0x2, 0x6) at skin colour 16 whose textures are not in the package

BloodElf.comment: Blood Elf keeps every package skin, the fel ones too.

HighElf.reason: High Elf skins: the plain Blood Elf tones go on the purple ramp of skins.json. Kept: the ten stock tones the realm's High Elves have today (and the Death Knight skins); the package's other Blood Elf tones are near-duplicates on a ten-colour ramp until the owner's High Elf contact sheet picks them (customize lists the ones that fit at least near_duplicate_delta_e apart). Marked skins stay only when listed in keep_skins (their marks must survive the recolour); fel skins never: High Elves have no fel options.

Draenei.reason: fel Draenei skins belong to the Eredar only

Eredar.comment: Eredar keeps every Draenei skin, the fel ones too.

notes: Rows of package races 12-21 (Skeleton 15, Taunka 19, ...) are never taken: races 15 and 19 are High Elf and Eredar on this realm, cloned from the merged Blood Elf (10) and Draenei (11).

Rows the package names but does not ship (Dwarf female scalps at hair colours 13-22, Draenei male features at hair colours 10-21, a few single faces and scalps) are rebuilt on the server from the nearest texture of the same style, recoloured to the target colour; with no source the row is hidden and the report says so.
Repeated rows (Blood Elf male has 170 repeated features rows) keep only the last, the one the client uses today.
No section-2 (features) row is ever hidden: the client counts features by position, so a hole would lose the last value.
Off-lore tones (for example Night Elf female 25, orange with flame tattoos) stay unless the owner asks to hide them.
